title: First Steps: A Forest Edge
blurb: Learn the basics: see what the threat will do, restore land and defend it.
hints: Red arrows show exactly where the pasture will spread at the end of your turn. Nothing is hidden.
Defend a tile an arrow points at and it is safe this turn. Restore lifts a tile one step: Lost, Damaged, Healthy.
You get 3 Energy (⚡) a turn and it does not carry over. Spend it all, then end the turn.
realWorld: Look for credible deforestation-free labels (such as FSC on wood and paper) and ask retailers where their beef, soy and palm oil come from.
